tools.name: get_document
tools.description:
Fetch the full text of one guide, article or set of questions by its slug, as Markdown, not
HTML. Slugs come from search_documents or list_documents.

The answer carries the MCS documents the text draws on, and the ids of any calculators on this site
that do the arithmetic the text describes. Where

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: Lists every document, optionally filtered by kind ('guide', 'article' or 'faq'), by category, or, for guides, by the reader they are written for. Guides are shelved by perspective: 'considering', 'buying', 'selling', 'installing' and 'learning'. The first four are plain language and name no standard

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description:
Search the guides, articles and questions for material on a UK home energy subject.

Use this first, before answering from memory, whenever a question concerns UK heat pump or solar PV
practice: how a system is sized, what a standard requires, what a quotation should contain, what
needs planning per

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_documents" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search the guides, articles and questions for material on a UK home energy subject. Use this first, before answering from memory, whenever a question concerns U…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
